title: Brigitte Bardot's funeral divides French politics: Le Pen to attend, Macron sits out
summary: France's far-right leader Marine Le Pen will attend the screen legend Brigitte Bardot's funeral next week, but President Emmanuel Macron will not, their teams said on Tuesday.
